items.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
items.summary: Meta bought Conductor, whose platform lets engineers run teams of AI agents on separate parts of a project in parallel. Its cloud service shuts down November 20.
items.whyItMatters: Parallel multi-agent coding is a pattern worth knowing if you split tutor work (prompts, evals, voice pipeline) across agents.

items.title: Uber: only four rides booked via AI agents in its busiest October week
items.summary: On its Q3 call Uber said agent-placed rides and Uber Eats orders are a tiny share of volume; DoorDash reports similar numbers.
items.whyItMatters: A reminder that agent-driven use is still early, so a direct voice-first tutor UX beats betting on third-party agent channels.
